title: Lanes stay package-disjoint: wire fleet.PartitionGraph into dispatch
summary: fleet.PartitionGraph partitions by the module-internal import graph, but it is not wired into dispatch (docs/architecture/packages/internal-fleet.md, status 2026-10-09). File-disjoint lanes can still conflict through a shared package. Current research partitions by cohesion of the dependency graph (arXiv 2606.00953).
fix: Plan component O3 (D6, D7), spec section 6. This is ADR-0134 S14, built under ADR-0139: admission by package cell through fleet.PartitionGraph, with the hub cell at capacity 1, in shadow first. A todo with no files takes the cell of its named package, or the hub cell. Design: docs/plans/wave-orchestrator-2026-10.md and docs/architecture/wave-orchestrator.md (ADR-0139).
acceptance: In shadow, 3 runs show an admission width cost of at most 10%.
